items.title: Microsoft outlines digital sovereignty options with more control and choice
items.summary_en: Per a search-result snippet of the Official Microsoft Blog post, Microsoft described options for customers seeking greater control over data and operations. The snippet says GitHub Enterprise Local is expected to become generally available at Microsoft Ignite. The full post could not be fetched, so details are unverified.
